rubric: A listing is 'relevant' to a query when its garment type is, in everyday usage, a kind of the noun asked for AND any colour/material/size/price words in the query do not contradict it. Labels were written by reading data/listings.json, not by running any search. Where the data has no exact match (e.g. 'corduroy jacket'), any item of the right garment type is an acceptable fallback and a wrong-type item is not.
